about: The CLAW rulebook for alfa, compiled into the sealed core. The agent's instructions (PORTABLE_O.md) and alfa's code (walls.mjs) read the same rules from this one file. CLAW is a devudaaaa Labs project; this file applies its policy model as a pattern.

outbound.verdict: ask; deny on a work machine

destructive.meaning: deletes or overwrites data in a way that is hard to undo

install.meaning: installs or runs software fetched from elsewhere

root.meaning: changes the sealed core (only a signed release may do that)
